> **PR title must follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org):** `feat: ...` (minor), `fix: ...` / `perf: ...` (patch), `feat!: ...` (breaking), or `docs:` / `chore:` / `ci:` / `test:` / `refactor:` (no release). The title becomes the commit on `main` and decides the next version.

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs / `.env.sample` updated if behavior or config changed
